ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low-intensity (black) pixels dominate approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with high-intensity (white) pixels constituting the remaining 10% in localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base across both lobes; high-contrast white focal points and linear patterns are concentrated on the central-left lobe and the upper-lateral margins of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 52 degrees and a deep vertical penetration relative to the lobe heights.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations on the left lobe trailing edge with pixel-amplitudes ranging from 2-8 pixels; right lobe edge exhibits a significant macroscopic discontinuity/indentation near the distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Left lobe follows a standard convex curve to a sharp tip; right lobe exhibits a convex proximal sweep followed by a blunt, truncated distal termination.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular white pixel clusters detected; most prominent rosette located in the mid-left lobe region, with secondary smaller clusters along the right lobe's trailing edge.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive parallel linear disruptions (rake marks) observed on the left lobe's upper quadrant and scattered horizontal linear scarring on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Severe distal amputation or tissue loss on the right lobe tip, creating a jagged, non-biological terminal edge; extensive rake mark scarring across both ventral surfaces.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'comb' pattern of five parallel vertical rake marks on the medial section of the left lobe.
